event_summary: A black kettlebell-shaped object and a suspended green sheet move downward toward two pillows, with the kettlebell contacting and indenting the left pillow while the green sheet comes to rest on the right pillow.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with two light gray pillows side by side on a wooden platform against a wall. A black kettlebell-shaped object hangs above the left pillow, and a green rectangular sheet hangs from a blue-and-black vertical strap above the right pillow. After an initial still interval, the kettlebell-shaped object moves downward and contacts the top of the left pillow, where the pillow surface visibly lowers and wrinkles around it. At about the same period, the green sheet moves downward, tilts, touches the right pillow, bends from a vertical hanging position toward a flatter position, and remains lying across the top surface of the right pillow while the vertical strap remains above it.

reasons: Both pillows are fully visible on the platform.
The suspended black kettlebell-shaped object is visible above the left pillow.
The green hanging sheet and its strap are visible above the right pillow.
No main contact between the suspended objects and pillows is visible in the first frame.
